text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different formats, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands. Data modeling means planning how to organize the data before we build the database. Indexes help speed up searches, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database and designing it well makes applications faster and easier to manage.
